listing.name: God Hand — God Hand Recompiled (LasVola)
listing.summary: Upstream reports playing into stage 3 from a source build. Later stages and endings remain untested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-21503 ISO. Compare its exact hash with the upstream guide before setup; this guide does not include that hash.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local generation, module and build instructions with your own SLUS21503 ISO. No ready-to-use player package is confirmed.

warnings: Upstream reports playing into stage 3 from a source build. Later stages and endings remain untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
